label: GST registration turnover threshold (business)
quote: when your business or enterprise has a GST turnover (gross income from all businesses minus GST) of $75,000 or more (the GST threshold)
pattern: minus GST\) of (\$[\d,]+) or more \(the GST threshold\)
notes: Non-profit threshold is $150,000. The page states no start date. $75,000 was first specified in regulation 23-15.01 of the 1999 regulations by the A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Amendment Regulations 2007 (No. 2) (SLI 2007 No. 206), which commenced on 1 July 2007: https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/pdf/reg/r20070206.pdf. The A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Regulations 2019 keep the amount in s 23-15.01: https://www.legislation.gov.au/F2019L00417/latest
